title: sess_init failure log omits provider name
description: fd.c:787: pr_err_ratelimited("init('%.*s'): sess_init failed: %d\n", CRYPTO2DEV_ALGO_MAXLEN, op.algo, ret) — omits provider name. actual_provider is a valid non-NULL pointer at this point (lookup already succeeded). A support engineer cannot determine from the ring buffer whether the sess_init failure came from wolfssl or kcapi without additional binary search. Fix: add "%.*s" + actual_provider to the format string.
